# MDL019: mdl-orphan-file

> Generated: do not edit this page. Regenerate with `cargo dev gen rules`.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| family | MDL |

| must_measure | false |
| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

A .grmb file in the walk is reachable from no model root.

Only files reachable from a root listed in `[grimble] models` through `include` are loaded. Include the file from a root, list it as a root, or exclude it with `[check] exclude`; rustc ignores unreachable files silently, grimble does not.

## Examples

### MDL019 orphan file / A file reachable from no root fires #1 (line 6) (fire)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
=== grimble.toml
[grimble]
models = ["design/model.grmb"]
=== design/stray.grmb
grimble = "2";
part of m;
```

### MDL019 orphan file / An included file is clean #2 (line 19) (clean)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
include "a.grmb";
=== grimble.toml
[grimble]
models = ["design/model.grmb"]
=== design/a.grmb
grimble = "2";
part of m;
```
